mapper.select:
with tmp as ( select A.FINPROD_ID, A.CDATE, A.INV_AIM, SUM(A.AMOUNT) AMOUNT from PTL_SEC_POSITION A INNER JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO C ON A.PORTFOLIO_ID = C.PORTFOLIO_ID AND C.INVEST_YESORNO = 'Y' INNER JOIN FIN_PRODUCT B ON A.FINPROD_ID = B.FINPROD_ID AND B.FINPROD_TYPE2 IN ('F01', 'F18') --债券、项目类 where A.HODING_TYPE = '03' --实际持仓 GROUP BY A.FINPROD_ID, A.CDATE, A.INV_AIM ) SELECT A.FINPROD_ID finprodId, A.FINPROD_ABBR finprodName FROM fin_product a inner join fin_product_type b on a.FINPROD_ID = b.FINPROD_ID where ( (b.type_8 = 'F01' or (b.type_8 = 'F06' and b.type_9 in ('08', '09'))) and exists( select 1 from tmp c where c.FINPROD_ID = a.FINPROD_ID and c.INV_AIM = 'AC'
and c.CDATE = to_date(#{execDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'yyyy-MM-dd')
and c.AMOUNT != 0 ) )
and (instr(A.FINPROD_ID, #{search}) > 0 or instr(A.FINPROD_NAME, #{search}) > 0 or instr(A.FINPROD_ABBR, #{search}) > 0)
and A.FINPROD_ID = #{initValue}
AND A.FINPROD_ID IN
#{item}

SELECT A.FINPROD_ID as finprodId,/**金融产品代码**/ A.FINPROD_ABBR as finprodName/**金融产品简称**/ FROM FIN_PRODUCT A /**标的类金融产品表**/ INNER JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE D ON A.FINPROD_ID = D.FINPROD_ID/**金融产品分类表**/ WHERE 1 = 1 AND D.TYPE_18 = '01' AND (D.TYPE_1 = '033' OR (A.IS_SUS = '01' AND A.IS_RIGHT = '02'))/**优先股、不含权的永续债**/ AND ( EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM BOK_VAL_SCHEME_DETAIL_SPECIAL WHERE VALUATION_PRICE = 'MOD' AND FINPROD_ID = A.FINPROD_ID ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM BOK_VAL_SCHEME_DETAIL F WHERE VALUATION_PRICE = 'MOD' AND D.TYPE_18 = F.SEC_TYPE AND (D.TYPE_1 = F.SEC_DETAIL_TYPE OR F.SEC_DETAIL_TYPE IS NULL) ) )
